'''Ged Ku'rys''' was an indecisive [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] individual who served as the leader of the [[Ku'rys]] clan on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. [[Emen Rooshan]], a member of the rival [[Rooshan]] clan, hired an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] in an attempt to kill Ku'rys.<ref name="GatORW" />
